text:
Weeknight Chicken Fried Rice

This is the dish my kids beg for every Tuesday. Honestly, it started as a way to use up leftover rice, and now I cook extra rice on purpose!

Serves 4 | Prep 10 mins | Cook 15 mins | Total 25 mins

Ingredients
▢ 3 cups cooked jasmine rice, cold
▢ 2 tbsp vegetable oil
▢ 2 chicken thighs, diced
▢ 2 eggs, beaten
▢ 1 cup frozen peas and carrots
▢ 3 spring onions, sliced
▢ 2 tbsp soy sauce
▢ 1 tsp sesame oil

Instructions
1. Heat the oil in a wok over high heat. Cook the chicken for 5 minutes.
2. Push to the side, scramble the eggs, then add the rice and peas and carrots.
3. Add soy sauce and sesame oil, toss for 3 minutes, and finish with spring onions.

Did you make this? Leave a comment below and pin it for later!
title: Weeknight Chicken Fried Rice

hi love, here's nan's pumpkin soup like you asked x

- 1kg butternut pumpkin, peeled and chopped
- 1 brown onion
- 2 cloves garlic
- 1 litre chicken stock
- 1/2 cup cream
- pinch of nutmeg

fry the onion and garlic in a bit of butter, add pumpkin and stock and simmer till soft (about 25 min). blitz it, stir in the cream and nutmeg. feeds 6 easy. love nan

text:
Sticky Pork Ribs
Serves: 4
Total time: 2 hours 30 minutes

For the ribs:
1.5 kg pork ribs
1 tbsp smoked paprika
1 tsp salt

For the glaze:
1/2 cup barbecue sauce
2 tbsp honey
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar

Method
Rub the ribs with paprika and salt. Wrap in foil and bake at 160°C for 2 hours.
Mix the glaze. Unwrap, brush with glaze and bake 30 minutes more at 200°C.
title: Sticky Pork Ribs

text:
CHOC CHIP COOKIES
Makes 24
125g butter
1/2 cup brown sugar
1 egg
1 1/2 cups plain flour
1 cup chocolate chips
Cream butter and sugar, add egg, fold in flour and chips. Bake 12 min at 180°C.

ANZAC BISCUITS
Makes 20
1 cup rolled oats
1 cup plain flour
1 cup desiccated coconut
125g butter
2 tbsp golden syrup
Melt butter and syrup, mix into the dry ingredients, bake 15 min at 160°C.
title: Choc chip cookies

text:
Lemon Yoghurt Cake
Serves 8 · 1 hr 10 min

• 1½ cups self-raising flour
• ¾ cup caster sugar
• 2 eggs
• ¾ cup Greek yoghurt
• ⅓ cup vegetable oil
• Zest and juice of 1 lemon
• Icing sugar, to dust (optional)

1. Whisk everything except the icing sugar together until smooth.
2. Pour into a lined loaf tin and bake at 170°C for 50–55 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.
title: Lemon Yoghurt Cake

Dahl (Serves 4-6)

* 1 cup red lentils, rinsed
- 1 onion, finely chopped
* 2 tsp curry powder
- 400ml coconut milk
* 2 cups vegetable stock
- handful of baby spinach

Cook the onion, add the curry powder, then the lentils, coconut milk and stock. Simmer 20 min. Stir in the spinach.

text:
Chicken tikka skewers
Serves 4

Ingredients
For the marinade:
1 cup greek yoghurt
2 tsp garam masala
1 tbsp lemon juice
For the skewers:
600 g chicken thigh, cubed
1 red onion, in chunks
To serve:
Lemon wedges

Method
1. Mix the marinade, add the chicken and rest 1 hour.
2. Thread onto skewers with the onion and grill 10 minutes.
3. Serve with lemon wedges.
title: Chicken tikka skewers
